settings.title: Can I see a mockup?
settings.text: Absolutely! Send over your high resolution vector file(s) and we'll get a mockup over to you in 24 hours or fewer.

settings.title: Do you have minimums?
settings.text: Our minimum order quantity is just 12 units for custom logo orders.

settings.title: How long will it take to get my order?
settings.text: Our standard turnaround time on custom logo orders is 30 days.

settings.title: Can I order your products without a custom logo?
settings.text: Yes, our products are often used for promotional purposes with or without custom logos.

settings.title: If I order your products without a custom logo, does it still take 30 days to arrive?
settings.text:
No, standard products typically arrive in fewer than 7 business days
.

settings.title: What's in the Rangefinder box?
settings.text: Rangefinder, carrying case, mountaineer buckle, lanyard, cleaning cloth, CR2-3V batteries (x3), Blue Tees sticker, manual + insert

settings.title: What's in the PLAYER Speaker box?
Can we use a multicolor logo?
settings.text: Yes, you can add additional colors for $15/color.

settings.title: What type of file does the logo need to be? If we don’t have that type of file can you create one?
settings.text: A vector or ai file is required. If you do not have a high resolution vector file, our team can build one for you for $40.

settings.title: Do you provide samples? Spec samples?
settings.text: Yes, we can provide a blank sample. We do not provide spec samples at this time.

settings.title: Is there a set up fee?
settings.text: Yes, there is a $75 set up fee, which is waived at a 120 unit order.
